238OUg77XvIu1IqF8ETrxQ.zh: 菲律賓受洪災影響,致疫情上升,今年截至8/29累計通報6,253例確定病例及378例死亡(CFR 6%),雖較去年同期7,084例減少12% ,惟考量潛伏期,預估8月底洪災衍生之病例仍可能持續增加,目前部分醫院已超額收治。當局提供120萬顆Doxycycline抗生素進行預防性投藥,並呼籲涉水且發燒⺠眾應儘速就醫 。
238OUg77XvIu1IqF8ETrxQ.en: Flooding in the Philippines has led to rising cases. As of 29 August this year, 6,253 confirmed cases and 378 deaths (CFR 6%) have been reported cumulatively. Although this is 12% lower than the 7,084 cases in the same period last year, given the incubation period, cases arising from the flooding at the end of August are expected to keep increasing, and some hospitals are already over capacity. Authorities are providing 1.2 million doxycycline tablets for preventive treatment and urge people who have waded through floodwater and developed fever to seek medical care promptly.

E0sLB7kRICw38SZdjatn-w.zh: 菲律賓疫情上升,今年截至8/22累計報告849例疑病例及52例確定病例,較去年同期(662例)增加36%。其中第八行政區今年累計報告405例,遠高於去年6例,疫情已超越流行閾。
E0sLB7kRICw38SZdjatn-w.en: The Philippines' epidemic is rising: as of 22 August this year, 849 suspected cases and 52 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, 36% more than the 662 cases in the same period last year. Region VIII reported 405 cases cumulatively this year, far above 6 cases last year, and the epidemic has exceeded the epidemic threshold.

HMPvbd-gh0VZUXrxUt4VPA.zh: 菲律賓宿霧省(Cebu)疫情上升,今年截至8/18累計報告2,324例病例,其中17例死亡,自7月進入雨季以來積水增加,致疫情顯著上升;鄰近之薄荷省(Bohol)亦爆發疫情,今年截至8/22累計報告1,883例病例,較去年同期增加7%,已至少20例死亡,致死率(CFR:1.17%)已超過該國設定之流行閾(1%),且全省12 個行政區已連續3週逾流行閾,疫情以塔利邦(Talibon)、塔比拉蘭(Tagbilaran City)及烏拜(Ubay)最為嚴重,當局已宣佈進入疫情警示。 馬來西亞疫情快速上升,今年迄今累計報告逾6.2萬例病例,其中60例死亡,疫情較去年同期增加60%。當局已啟動應變中,於吉隆坡與雪蘭莪州(Selangor )等熱點部署,擴大釋放沃爾巴克氏菌(Wolbachia)轉染的蚊子以進行生物防治,並進行登革熱疫苗成本效益分析,評估可能納入國家常規疫苗接種計畫。 印度今年截至7月累計報告3萬3,060例病例,與去年同期相當,其中7月新增1萬122例,較6月增加53%。該國病例通常於每年5-6月(季風雨季開始)呈現上升趨勢,並在9-10月達到全年高峰。 歐洲今年截至8/5僅有法國報告4例本土病例。研究顯示因為氣候變遷因素,2015-24年歐洲的疫情發生風險,為1982-2010年的3倍。
HMPvbd-gh0VZUXrxUt4VPA.en: In Cebu Province, Philippines, dengue is rising: as of 18 August this year, 2,324 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 17 deaths; standing water has increased since the rainy season began in July, causing a marked rise. Neighbouring Bohol Province has also had an outbreak: as of 22 August this year, 1,883 cases have been reported cumulatively, 7% more than the same period last year, with at least 20 deaths. The case fatality rate (1.17%) exceeds the country's epidemic threshold (1%), and 12 administrative areas across the province have exceeded the threshold for three consecutive weeks; the outbreak is most serious in Talibon, Tagbilaran City and Ubay. Authorities have declared an outbreak alert. Malaysia's outbreak is rising rapidly: as of this year, more than 62,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, including 60 deaths, 60% more than the same period last year. Authorities have activated a response and are deploying hotspot measures in Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, expanding the release of Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes for biological control, and conducting a cost-effectiveness analysis of a dengue vaccine to assess whether it could be included in the national routine vaccination programme. India reported 33,060 cases cumulatively through July this year, similar to the same period last year; 10,122 were added in July, 53% more than in June. Cases in India usually rise from May to June, at the start of the monsoon rains, and reach an annual peak in September–October. In Europe, as of 5 August this year, only France had reported 4 locally acquired cases. Studies show that climate change has made the risk of dengue outbreaks in Europe during 2015–24 three times that of 1982–2010.

2UWzAr66N0CP5evR0-LXlw.zh: 菲律賓受降雨影響,該國衛生部截至8/17累計報告 3,760例確定病例,低於去年同期,其中以奎松市最為嚴峻,兩週內爆增62例病例及5例死亡,高達71%為男性(44例),多為司機、保全、清潔工及外送員等環境涉水者。目前大馬拉都會區(Metro Manila)多家大型醫院滿床,被迫限制非緊急收治。當局呼籲涉水⺠眾應穿戴防護、及早投藥預防,出現疑症狀應儘速就醫。
2UWzAr66N0CP5evR0-LXlw.en: The Philippines is affected by heavy rainfall. The Department of Health reported 3,760 confirmed cases cumulatively as of 17 August, lower than the same period last year. Quezon City is the most serious, with 62 cases and 5 deaths added in two weeks; 71% of cases were male (44), mostly people working in water-exposed environments such as drivers, security guards, cleaners and delivery riders. Many large hospitals in Metro Manila are currently full, and some have been forced to restrict non-emergency admissions. Authorities urge people who wade through water to wear protective equipment and take preventive medication early, and to seek medical care promptly if they develop suspicious symptoms.

9I_7qadmkNqAL3qTHaRtOQ.zh: 越南胡志明市今年截至第30週(7/20-26)累計報告2萬3,481例病例,較去年同期增加23.9%,其中第30週報告995例病例,較近4週平均增加20%。 菲律賓三寶顏市(Zamboanga)於8/4宣布爆發疫情,今年截至8月初已報告1,241例病例及12例死亡。該市疫情持續上升,已達流行閾,超過50%感染者為10歲(含)以下兒童,全市有39個(/98)行政區受到影響,當局已加強防治措施。
9I_7qadmkNqAL3qTHaRtOQ.en: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, has reported 23,481 dengue cases cumulatively up to week 30 (20–26 July) this year, a 23.9% increase over the same period last year. Of these, 995 cases were reported in week 30, 20% above the average of the previous four weeks. On 4 August, Zamboanga City in the Philippines declared an outbreak; as of early August, 1,241 cases and 12 deaths had been reported this year. Cases in the city continue to rise and have reached the epidemic threshold, with more than 50% of infections among children aged 10 years and under. Thirty-nine of the city's 98 administrative districts are affected, and authorities have strengthened prevention and control measures.

RNN6rbB5tzh7Ip3eH-1Qpw.zh: 斯里蘭卡今年截至7/30累計報告84,724例病例,其中62例死亡(CFR: 0.07%),其中7月報告約2.9萬例,疫情集中於加姆珀哈區(Gampaha District),以第二型(DENV-2)血清型傳播力為高。近一週病例數雖下降3%,惟住院數仍高,當局已增加登革熱高風險告警區域。 泰國今年截至第30週(8/1)累計報告1萬7,299例病例,病患多介於10-19歲,死亡率最高的年齡層為40-49歲及60歲以上,疫情低於預測且低於去年同期。 菲律賓宿霧(Cebu)今年截至7/18累計報告1228例病例,其中10 例死亡,病例數較去年同期增加12.35%;另三寶顏市(Zamboanga)今年截至7/25累計報告1,184例,疫情較去年同期增加20%,其中11例死亡(多為10歲以下兒童)。
RNN6rbB5tzh7Ip3eH-1Qpw.en: Sri Lanka has reported 84,724 dengue cases cumulatively this year up to 30 July, including 62 deaths (CFR: 0.07%). About 29,000 cases were reported in July alone. The outbreak is concentrated in Gampaha District, where transmission of DENV-2 serotype is high. Although cases fell 3% over the past week, hospitalizations remain high, and authorities have expanded high-risk dengue alert areas. Thailand has reported 17,299 cases cumulatively this year as of week 30 (1 August), mostly among people aged 10–19 years. The highest mortality is among those aged 40–49 years and 60 years and above. Cases are below forecasts and lower than the same period last year. In the Philippines, Cebu has reported 1,228 cases cumulatively as of 18 July, including 10 deaths, a 12.35% increase over the same period last year. Zamboanga City has reported 1,184 cases cumulatively as of 25 July, a 20% increase over the same period last year, including 11 deaths, mostly among children under 10 years.

w78d858eOu3Mqa7ZwSD8Pg.zh: 菲律賓進入雨季後疫情上升,該國今年迄至6月初累計報告2,177 例確定病例,較去年同期增加6%,其中以伊洛伊洛省(Iloilo)疫情最為嚴峻,該省之CFR為 11.6%(自2025年同期2例增加至8例死亡),個案多為農⺠與經常涉水者,因常接觸受感染鼠類尿液污染之水體及土壤,導致感染風險增加。
w78d858eOu3Mqa7ZwSD8Pg.en: As the rainy season begins, cases in the Philippines have risen. As of early June this year, 2,177 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, 6% more than the same period last year. The most severe outbreak is in Iloilo Province, where the case fatality ratio is 11.6% (deaths increased from 2 in the same period of 2025 to 8). Most cases are farmers and people who frequently wade through water, and exposure to water and soil contaminated by rodent urine increases the risk of infection.

byaco5VebkRsEtieGQ_GiQ.zh: 中國今年4-6月報告78例,其中廣東省今年截至5月報告36例。該國去年截至12/4累計報告2萬9,497例,曾於廣東省佛山去年7月爆發之大規模疫情已於11月受到控制(累計2萬5,826例)。 菲律賓薩馬省(Samar)疫情上升,今年2/5-7/13累計報告329例疑病例,疫情高峰落於第26週,病患分布以巴塞(Basey)和甘達拉(Gandara)鎮為多,年齡集中於10-29歲,該國近期已展開社區衛教活動。 法屬圭亞那疫情擴張,今年截至7/16累計報告1,157例確定病例,其中2例死亡,且有210例極可能或確定病例住院,並有出現母子垂直感染之案例,病例在部分醫院占其急診就診數的4-6%,疫情高峰落於4月底至5月中,惟近期可能有通報延遲之情形,當局已發布警報。
byaco5VebkRsEtieGQ_GiQ.en: China reported 78 cases in April to June this year, of which Guangdong Province reported 36 as of May. The country had reported 29,497 cases as of 4 December last year. A large-scale outbreak in Foshan, Guangdong, which began in July last year, was brought under control in November (25,826 cases cumulatively). In Samar Province, Philippines, cases are rising. From 5 February to 13 July this year, 329 suspected cases have been reported cumulatively. The peak fell in week 26, cases are concentrated in the towns of Basey and Gandara, and most patients are aged 10 to 29 years. The country has recently launched community health education activities. In French Guiana, the outbreak is expanding. As of 16 July this year, 1,157 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 2 deaths. Of the probable or confirmed cases, 210 were hospitalized, and cases of vertical mother-to-child transmission have been reported. In some hospitals, cases account for 4–6% of emergency department visits. The peak fell between late April and mid-May, but reporting may have been delayed recently, and authorities have issued an alert.

g_jiNU69EMz8OCr_jZ-kjg.zh: 菲律賓東部薩馬省(Samar)甘達拉(Gandara)今年自5月截至7/9累計報告至少84例病例,疫情多集中於2個相鄰村莊,當局已發布紅色警戒,並加強當地環境孳清等防治措施及積極監測其餘67個村莊之疫情。
g_jiNU69EMz8OCr_jZ-kjg.en: In Gandara, Samar Province, eastern Philippines, at least 84 cases have been reported cumulatively from May this year to 9 July. Cases are concentrated in 2 neighbouring villages. Authorities have issued a red alert, strengthened local control measures such as eliminating mosquito breeding sites, and are actively monitoring the remaining 67 villages.

1d0hI_-YHts0keBHFLd9bA.zh: 菲律賓曼達盧永市(Mandaluyong City)報告1例本土確定病例。當局已啟動疫調與接觸者追蹤。截至今年6/13止,該國累計報告55例確定病例,較2025年大幅降低約79%(減少205例)。
1d0hI_-YHts0keBHFLd9bA.en: Mandaluyong City in the Philippines has reported 1 locally acquired confirmed case, and authorities have launched epidemiological investigation and contact tracing. As of 13 June this year, the country has reported 55 confirmed cases cumulatively, a sharp decrease of about 79% (205 fewer cases) compared with 2025.

gXSWLNPoN1kIDU06HiePqA.zh: 香港報告 1 例本土病例,病患為 30 歲男性,於 4/14 起出現肌肉痛及發燒等症狀,4/17 出現皮疹就醫,4/18 經實驗室確診。病患為香港於4/3 及 4/6 公布之確診個案之密切接觸者,皆同於機場工作,無國外旅遊史,當局已啟動診所及機場等密切接觸者匡列作業,並呼籲民眾接種麻疹疫苗。 菲律賓國家首都區奎松市今年截至 4/16 報告 143 確診病例,其中 1 例死亡。76%病患為 10 歲以下兒童(109 例),且其中 23 例為未達接種疫苗年齡嬰兒,當局已啟動相關防治及疫苗接種措施。該國今年第一季累計報告 1,627 例麻疹/德國麻疹確定病例,較去年同期增加 45%。
gXSWLNPoN1kIDU06HiePqA.en: Hong Kong reported one local case: a 30-year-old man who developed muscle pain and fever from 14 April, presented with a rash on 17 April, and was laboratory-confirmed on 18 April. He is a close contact of the confirmed cases announced by Hong Kong on 3 and 6 April; all of them worked at the airport, and none had a history of travel abroad. Authorities have activated contact tracing for close contacts in clinics and at the airport, and urge the public to get measles vaccination. Quezon City in the National Capital Region of the Philippines reported 143 confirmed cases this year as of 16 April, including one death. 76% of patients are children under 10 (109 cases), and 23 of them were infants too young to be vaccinated. Authorities have launched related prevention and vaccination measures. In the first quarter of this year, the Philippines reported 1,627 confirmed measles and rubella cases cumulatively, 45% more than in the same period last year.

SCztQ2gp0ZVuVJhgvITcTg.zh: 菲律賓今(2026)年截至3/21累計報告1,627 確定病例,較去(2025)年同期新增45%, 其中1,111 例(68%)未接種疫苗,病例數以南部邦薩莫洛自治區(344例)、南部索科斯克薩爾根大區(322例)、南部達沃區(163例)、國家首都區(158例)為多,當局呼籲民眾接種疫苗。
SCztQ2gp0ZVuVJhgvITcTg.en: As of 21 March this year, the Philippines has reported 1,627 confirmed cases, 45% higher than the same period last year. Of these, 1,111 cases (68%) were unvaccinated. Cases are concentrated in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (344 cases), SOCCSKSARGEN (322 cases), Davao Region (163 cases) and the National Capital Region (158 cases). Authorities urge the public to get vaccinated.

SEk9fdwl_Tiduzh9uBmiVA.zh: 菲律賓今年第1-7週(1/4-2/21)累計報告17例病例,低於去年同期(49例),超過7成的病患係遭未接種的寵物或流浪狗咬傷而感染。另該國每年平均發生400萬件動物抓咬傷案件,造成300-400例狂犬病感染死亡。
SEk9fdwl_Tiduzh9uBmiVA.en: The Philippines reported 17 cases in weeks 1–7 this year (4 January–21 February), fewer than the 49 cases in the same period last year. More than 70% of patients were infected through bites from unvaccinated pets or stray dogs. The country records about 4 million animal bite and scratch incidents each year, causing 300–400 rabies deaths.

2jMIZZlhkH5IBj46T-E71w.zh: 菲律賓今(2025)年截至12/6報告4,843例確定病例,去(2024)年同期為3,748例,其中73%未接種疫苗,病例數以國家首都(Metro Manila)區1,027例、南部邦薩莫洛自治區(Bangsamoro)768例及北部卡拉巴松地區(Calabarzon)505例為多,當局已宣布於明(2026)年啟動加強疫苗接種計畫。The Philippine News Agency 12/20 墨西哥疫情上升,今年截至12/19報告5,860例確定病例,其中24例死亡,病例數以西北部契瓦瓦州(4,473例)、中西部哈利斯科州(462例)、西南部雷羅州(227例)為多,病患主要年齡層為0-4歲兒童,其中90%以上未接種疫苗。RECORD 12/21
2jMIZZlhkH5IBj46T-E71w.en: The Philippines reported 4,843 confirmed cases in 2025 as of 6 December, compared with 3,748 in the same period of 2024. 73% were unvaccinated. Cases were most numerous in the National Capital Region (Metro Manila) with 1,027, the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in the south with 768, and the Calabarzon region in the north with 505. Authorities have announced that an intensified vaccination programme will start next year (2026) (Philippine News Agency, 20 December). Mexico's situation is rising. This year as of 19 December, 5,860 confirmed cases had been reported, including 24 deaths. Cases were most numerous in Chihuahua state in the northwest (4,473), Jalisco state in the central-west (462) and Guerrero state in the southwest (227). The main age group is children aged 0–4, and over 90% were unvaccinated (RECORD, 21 December).

YgRlryT_7NLc8O_vIGUlLQ.zh: 菲律賓中米沙鄢報告自今年11月初截至12/10累計報告744例病例,其中715例已康復,多數病例於暴露洪水後出現發燒、寒顫、頭痛及睛紅腫等症狀。當局呼籲民眾接觸汙水汙泥後,倘發生疑症狀,應儘速就醫。
YgRlryT_7NLc8O_vIGUlLQ.en: Central Visayas, Philippines, reported 744 cumulative cases from early November this year to 10 December, of which 715 have recovered. Most cases developed fever, chills, headache and red, swollen eyes after exposure to flood water. Authorities urge people who develop suspicious symptoms after contact with sewage or sludge to seek medical care promptly.

ZGKA4A_8KlgLhAn6OssuCg.zh: 孟加拉疫情更新,第48週(11/24-30)新增4,128例病例及13例死亡,病例數較前1週5,267例下降21.6%,今年截至11/30累計95,081例病例及380例死亡,該國去年同期累計92,351例病例及497例死亡。 菲律賓奎松市今年截至12/11累計報告10,740例病例及46例死亡,病例年齡分布以1-10歲為多,54%病例為男性。
ZGKA4A_8KlgLhAn6OssuCg.en: Bangladesh update: in week 48 (24–30 November), 4,128 new cases and 13 deaths were reported. Cases fell 21.6% from 5,267 in the previous week. Cumulatively this year to 30 November, 95,081 cases and 380 deaths were reported; in the same period last year, the country reported 92,351 cases and 497 deaths. Quezon City, Philippines, has reported 10,740 cases and 46 deaths so far this year, as of 11 December. Most cases are in the 1–10 age group, and 54% of cases are male.

oATFeYMhl2DwqMB-OzBARg.zh: 菲律賓疫情下降,10/12-25報告14,038例病例,較9/28-10/11報告15,182例減少8%,惟當局表示颱風過後,仍存在疫情風險。 阿富汗自9月底以來疑病例數上升,今年共6省累計報告4,384例疑病例,其中楠哈爾省於11月第2週報告1,021例疑病例,較前1週948例增加7.7%。
oATFeYMhl2DwqMB-OzBARg.en: Philippines: Outbreak declining. From 12 to 25 October, 14,038 cases were reported, an 8% decrease from 15,182 cases reported from 28 September to 11 October. However, authorities say there remains a risk of outbreaks after the typhoon. Afghanistan: Suspected cases have risen since late September. A total of 4,384 suspected cases have been reported this year across six provinces. In Nangarhar province, 1,021 suspected cases were reported in the second week of November, up 7.7% from 948 the previous week.

ZNPDwjghOUjpusfxfHTvkA.zh: WHO西太平洋區3國病例數急遽增加,斐濟過去10年新增感染病例上升10倍,主要感染途徑為注射毒品,另有傳播至其他太平洋島國之疑慮;菲律賓自2010-24年新增感染病例增加6倍,主要感染族群為男男性行為者;巴布亞紐幾內亞宣布愛滋病毒感染為國家危機,以應對育齡婦女和兒童族群不斷上升之感染率。WHO及聯合國已召開會議,以因應該區愛滋病危機,並探討解決行動方案。 印度東部賈坎德邦柴巴薩市某醫院於10月爆發5名地中海貧血兒童,經輸血感染愛滋病毒事件,首例於9/13接受輸血,5週後(10/18)檢測陽性,經調查5名病患血型不相同,顯示為多名捐血者血液遭汙染,感染源調查中,另該院血庫與實驗室有多項違規事項,當局已宣布該院血庫僅提供緊急情況使用。
ZNPDwjghOUjpusfxfHTvkA.en: WHO's Western Pacific Region reports sharp increases in case numbers in three countries. In Fiji, new HIV infections have risen tenfold over the past 10 years, mainly through injecting drug use, and there are concerns about spread to other Pacific island countries. In the Philippines, new infections increased sixfold between 2010 and 2024, mainly among men who have sex with men. Papua New Guinea has declared HIV a national crisis to respond to rising infection rates among women of reproductive age and children. WHO and the United Nations have convened meetings to address the regional HIV crisis and discuss action plans. In India, at a hospital in Chaibasa city, Jharkhand state in eastern India, five children with thalassaemia were infected with HIV through blood transfusions in October. The first child received a transfusion on 13 September and tested positive five weeks later, on 18 October. Investigation found that the five patients had different blood types, indicating that blood from several donors was contaminated. The source of infection is under investigation. The hospital's blood bank and laboratory were found to have multiple violations, and authorities have announced that the hospital's blood bank will only provide blood for emergencies.

Z8JqMKTReV6YmyTFzaam_w.en: Bangladesh's outbreak is rising. In the past day, 1,143 new hospitalized cases were reported, with 282 in Dhaka division in central Bangladesh. In October, 18,098 cases were reported, and year to date about 65,000 cases and more than 200 deaths have been reported cumulatively, with the main concentration in Dhaka division. Philippines: Quezon City reported 8,729 cases and 30 deaths cumulatively this year as of 7 October. Cases are mainly among children under 10 years old (4,235 cases), and the number of cases is 91% higher than the same period last year (4,581 cases).

CaIJOOhpHobgwgSBR7JpWw.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第38週(9/15-21)全球陽性率17.41%,除歐洲及東地中海以外,各區署陽性率皆增加。 日本疫情呈下降趨勢,第39週(9/22-28)定醫平均報告數5.87,已連續2週下降,住院數呈下降趨勢,病患地理分布以東京都、神奈川縣為多,變異株以NB.1.8.1占比最高。 西太平區署第36-37週陽性率介於0-31.1%之間,其中,澳洲、柬埔寨、菲律賓及韓國疫情呈上升趨勢。 美國疫情呈下降趨勢,第39週陽性率6.7%,已連續5週下降,住院率亦下降,惟死亡率仍處高點,近期變異株以XFG占比最高(85%)。 英國疫情持續上升,惟處低點,第39週實驗監測陽性率8.4%,住院率亦上升,變異株以XFG.3(35%)及XFG(28%)占比為高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,除歐洲及東地中海以外,各區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
CaIJOOhpHobgwgSBR7JpWw.en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 38 of 2025 (15–21 September) was 17.41%, with positivity rising in all regional offices except Europe and the Eastern Mediterranean. Japan: The outbreak is declining. In week 39 (22–28 September), the average number of reports per sentinel clinic was 5.87, having declined for two consecutive weeks; hospitalizations are also declining. Cases are concentrated in Tokyo and Kanagawa prefecture, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Western Pacific regional office: In weeks 36–37, positivity rates ranged from 0 to 31.1%, and the outbreaks in Australia, Cambodia, the Philippines and South Korea are rising. United States: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate in week 39 was 6.7%, having declined for five consecutive weeks, and hospitalization rates have also declined, but the mortality rate remains high. The variant XFG has the highest share recently (85%). United Kingdom: The outbreak continues to rise but is at a low level. The laboratory surveillance positivity rate in week 39 was 8.4%, and hospitalization rates have also risen. The variants XFG.3 (35%) and XFG (28%) have high shares. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently shown an upward trend, with increases in all regional offices except Europe and the Eastern Mediterranean. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG, followed by NB.1.8.1. WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

q02iJuGx7Mri6EKxyM1-4w.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年9/26累計141國/地區報告16萬2千餘例確診病例,其中,至少430例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 全球今年截至第39週累計96國/地區報告4萬2千餘例確診病例,其中非洲區3萬5,363例、美洲區3,314例、歐洲區2,044例、西太平洋區1,229例、東南亞區95例及東地中海區40例。東地中海與歐洲疫情上升,非洲、美洲、西太平洋、東南亞疫情下降。  其他更新:  美國加州9/15報告新增1例I型病例,為該州第2例、該國第6例I型病例,病患近期具中東旅遊史,與其他病例無流行病學關聯。*加州首例為2024年11月報告。 塞內加爾自今年8月報告首例截至9/23累計4例病例,首例為境外移入Ib型病例,案2確診IIb型,與案1無流行病學關聯,案3、4為案2接觸者,推測感染為IIb型病例,當局已匡列40名接觸者。 愛爾蘭9/18報告3例Ib型確診病例及1例疑病例,首例確診病例與具中東旅遊史之疑病例具流行病關聯,餘2例確診者為首例之密切接觸者,其中有1名兒童,目前病患皆已康復。當局評估該國風險仍低,並呼籲旅外民眾應採取必要公衛措施。 科威特8/10報告該國首例M痘病例,為IIb型,迄今累計3例確診病例,首例具中國旅遊史,當局已疫調並匡列接觸者。 澳大利亞9/9報告新增1例Ib型病例,具中國及菲律賓旅遊史,為該國自2024年1月迄今第3例,當局已疫調並追蹤接觸者,並協助接種暴露後疫苗。 泰國9/9報告新增Ib型病例,病患為成年男性,具阿曼旅遊史。為該國自2024年1月迄今第6例Ib型病例。  評估與建議: WHO於9/5公布經IHR緊急委員會第5次會議討論,建議中止國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),WHO於記者會表示,剛果民主共和國/蒲隆地/獅子山/烏干達等國病例/死亡數持續下降,且對疾病傳播及嚴重度風險因素已逐漸掌握,受影響國家亦建立持續應對能力,不再構成PHEIC,惟提醒PHEIC解除並不代表威脅已經消失,非洲CDC仍持續列為非洲緊急衛生事件。WHO評估全球公共衛生風險為中等,由於不同基因型持續流行、監測及診斷能力不足、資金缺乏及社區參與需更多資源,WHO已將長期建議延長至2026年8月。
q02iJuGx7Mri6EKxyM1-4w.en: Monthly update: Since May 2022 and as of 26 September this year, 141 countries and areas have reported more than 162,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 430 died (CFR 0.2%). Year to date as of week 39, 96 countries and areas have reported more than 42,000 confirmed cases: 35,363 in the African Region, 3,314 in the Region of the Americas, 2,044 in the European Region, 1,229 in the Western Pacific Region, 95 in the South-East Asia Region and 40 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Cases have risen in the Eastern Mediterranean and Europe and declined in Africa, the Americas, the Western Pacific and South-East Asia. Other updates: On 15 September, California, United States, reported one new clade I case, the state's second and the country's sixth clade I case. The patient had recent travel history to the Middle East and no epidemiological link to other cases. The state's first case was reported in November 2024. Senegal reported its first case in August this year; as of 23 September, a cumulative 4 cases had been reported. The first case was an imported clade Ib case. Case 2 was confirmed as clade IIb and had no epidemiological link to case 1; cases 3 and 4 were contacts of case 2, and their infection is presumed to be clade IIb. Authorities have identified 40 contacts. Ireland reported three confirmed clade Ib cases and one suspected case on 18 September. The first confirmed case was epidemiologically linked to a suspected case with travel history to the Middle East; the other two confirmed cases were close contacts of the first, one of whom was a child. All patients have recovered. Authorities assess the country's risk as still low and urge travellers abroad to take necessary public health measures. Kuwait reported its first mpox case on 10 August; it was clade IIb, and 3 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively. The first case had travel history to China, and authorities have conducted an investigation and identified contacts. Australia reported one new clade Ib case on 9 September, with travel history to China and the Philippines; it is the country's third case since January 2024. Authorities have investigated and followed up contacts, and have helped administer post-exposure vaccines. Thailand reported a new clade Ib case on 9 September; the patient is an adult man with travel history to Oman, and it is the country's sixth clade Ib case since January 2024. Assessment and recommendations: On 5 September, WHO, following the fifth meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee, recommended ending the Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). At a press conference, WHO said case and death numbers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Burundi, Sierra Leone and Uganda continue to decline, risk factors for transmission and severity are increasingly understood, and affected countries have established sustained response capacity, so the event no longer constitutes a PHEIC. WHO cautioned that ending the PHEIC does not mean the threat has disappeared, and Africa CDC continues to treat the event as an emergency health event in Africa. WHO assesses the global public health risk as moderate. Because different genotypes continue to circulate, surveillance and diagnostic capacity are insufficient, funding is lacking, and community engagement requires more resources, WHO has extended its long-term recommendations to August 2026.

0DvdSd46LkHlrmu0OJS0Ig.zh: 菲律賓疫情持續,今年截至8/27累計報告4,436例,疫情逐步趨緩,惟當局仍針對近期洪水侵襲發出疫情警告,另建議有症狀之民眾可至鄰近之衛生中心或前往衛生部各醫院之鉤端螺旋體病快速通道就診。

jG7wccqpOab5MtoF1b1NTw.zh: 全球本月疫情更新:  自2022年5月截至今年8/28累計139國/地區報告15萬8,000餘例確診病例,其中至少399例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 今年截至第35週累計84國/地區報告3萬7千餘例確診病例,其中非洲區3萬1,980例、美洲區2,825例、歐洲區1,858例、西太平洋區1,067例、東南亞區82例及東地中海區33例。西太平洋疫情上升,歸因於中國、菲律賓今年7月單月新增皆逾100例病例。  其他更新:   肯亞疫情上升,自2024年7月報告首例病例截至今年8/17累計370例確診,其中6例死亡,死亡個案中有5例為HIV患者。病患多集中於該國東南方第二大港口城市蒙巴薩,病患過半數為20-40歲年輕人,該國近45%縣(21/47)皆報告病例,性接觸傳播為主要擴大因素,尤其是東非主要跨國公路之卡車司機、性工作者及商販等。 中國於8/1報告新增1例Ib型病例,為成年男性旅遊者,於7月中旬入境時回報症狀,當局展開疫調並採防範措施。另澳門於8/27報告今年首例境外移入病例,為該區自2023年第3例病例(前2例於2023年報告)。病患為29歲澳門男性居民,於8/23出現發熱、咽痛及腹瀉等症狀,曾於內地就診,26日返澳就醫確診,病患曾在旅遊時發生高風險性行為,惟未透露地點。 德國於8/19報告新增1例Ib型病例,為成年男性旅遊者,具阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)旅遊史,當局已追蹤接觸者並監測症狀。 土耳其報告3例Ib型病例,近期報告1例為7月下旬時確診,具阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)及埃及旅遊史,餘2例為回溯型病例,具烏干達旅遊史,當局已採疫調及隔離相關措施。 剛果民主共和國首次報告2例IIb型確診病例,指標個案為成年男性,具象牙海岸旅遊史,經分析該序列與象牙海岸及奈及利亞之病例相;案2為指標個案之接觸者,當局匡列25名接觸者追蹤,其中23名接種暴露後疫苗。該國首次檢出IIb型病例,顯示IIb型已進入Ia/Ib型流行區域,公共風險增加。  評估與建議: WHO宣布原定於2025/8/20到期之長期建議措施,因應全球流行病學情勢,將再延長1年,以預防及減少國際傳播及其對健康之影響。強調「持續監測、科學研究、社區合作與公平資源分配」是2025–26年全球防控核心,7大面向建議包括:國家防治計畫與政策持續優化、建立監測與實驗室診斷能力、加強社區保護與風險溝通、推動研究與臨床試驗、制定旅行相關措施(不鼓勵旅行禁令)、提供最佳臨床照護與醫護防護、確保公平獲得疫苗/診斷/治療。
jG7wccqpOab5MtoF1b1NTw.en: Global monthly outbreak update: since May 2022 and as of 28 August this year, 139 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 158,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 399 died (CFR: 0.2%). This year, as of week 35, 84 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 37,000 confirmed cases: African Region 31,980; Region of the Americas 2,825; European Region 1,858; Western Pacific Region 1,067; South-East Asia Region 82; and Eastern Mediterranean Region 33. The rise in the Western Pacific is attributed to China and the Philippines each reporting more than 100 new cases in July this year alone. Other updates: Kenya's outbreak is rising. Since the first case was reported in July 2024, 370 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported as of 17 August this year, including 6 deaths, five of which were in people living with HIV. Cases are concentrated in Mombasa, the country's second-largest port city in the south-east. More than half of patients are young adults aged 20–40. About 45% of the country's counties (21 of 47) have reported cases. Sexual transmission is the main driver of spread, particularly among truck drivers, sex workers and traders along the main East African transnational highway. China reported one new clade Ib case on 1 August: an adult male traveller who reported symptoms upon entry in mid-July. Authorities launched an epidemiological investigation and preventive measures. Macao reported its first imported case of this year on 27 August, the third case in the region since 2023 (the first two were reported in 2023). The patient is a 29-year-old male Macao resident who developed fever, sore throat and diarrhoea on 23 August. He had sought care on the mainland and returned to Macao for treatment on 26 August, where the infection was confirmed. The patient had high-risk sexual behaviour during travel, but did not disclose the location. Germany reported one new clade Ib case on 19 August: an adult male traveller with a travel history to the United Arab Emirates. Authorities have traced contacts and are monitoring symptoms. Turkey reported three clade Ib cases. One recent case was confirmed in late July and had a travel history to the UAE and Egypt; the other two were retrospective cases with a travel history to Uganda. Authorities have conducted epidemiological investigation and isolation measures. The Democratic Republic of the Congo reported its first two confirmed clade IIb cases. The index case is an adult male with a travel history to Côte d'Ivoire; analysis shows the sequence matches cases in Côte d'Ivoire and Nigeria. Case 2 is a contact of the index case; authorities have traced 25 contacts, 23 of whom received post-exposure vaccination. This is the country's first detection of clade IIb, indicating that clade IIb has entered areas where clade Ia/Ib circulates, increasing public risk. Assessment and recommendations: WHO announced that the long-term recommended measures, originally due to expire on 20 August 2025, will be extended by one year in view of the global epidemiological situation, to prevent and reduce international transmission and its health impact. It emphasizes that continued surveillance, scientific research, community cooperation and equitable resource allocation are the core of global prevention and control for 2025–26. Seven areas of recommendation are: continued optimization of national plans and policies; building surveillance and laboratory diagnostic capacity; strengthening community protection and risk communication; promoting research and clinical trials; formulating travel-related measures (travel bans are not encouraged); providing optimal clinical care and health-worker protection; and ensuring equitable access to vaccines, diagnostics and treatment.

6HLb6up7abQJ4FF4eo7j8A.en: The Philippines has reported 37,368 cases cumulatively this year as of 9 August, seven times the 5,081 cases in the same period of 2024. Half of the cases are children aged 1–3 years.

R-RoDkTqrKuirTpoXywStA.en: The outbreak in the Philippines continues: from 8 June to 7 August, 2,396 cases were cumulatively reported, with 569 cases in a single week. Urban flooding is intensifying the spread of the disease. Patient numbers have surged at hospitals in Metro Manila and other areas, and some emergency rooms are overloaded. Quezon City reported 207 cases as of 3 August this year, exceeding the epidemic threshold, of which 24 died. Last year the country had about 5,050 cases as of October.

KxUTIs1wBj0fEtA-J-vEaQ.zh: 菲律賓疫情上升,今年截至7/17累計報告3,037例病例,於7/13-31期間通報569例病例,當局表示該國連續數週暴風雨,導致病例增加,提醒民眾避免涉水,並於接觸後,清洗身體,倘出現相關症狀,應立即就醫,另警告民眾未經醫師處方,不得自行用藥或服用抗生素。 泰國今年截至7/17報告1,895例病例,其中25例死亡(CFR:1.32%),病例/死亡數均以年齡60歲以上族群為多,當局建議民眾避免涉水或至泥濘區域,或應穿戴靴子和手套等防護裝備,並於接觸後,清洗身體,另倘於涉水後1-2週出現相關症狀,應立即就醫並告知接觸史。
KxUTIs1wBj0fEtA-J-vEaQ.en: The outbreak in the Philippines is rising: as of 17 July this year, 3,037 cases had been cumulatively reported, and 569 cases were reported between 13 and 31 July. Authorities say several consecutive weeks of storms have increased cases. They remind the public to avoid wading through water, to wash the body after contact, and to seek medical care immediately if symptoms appear. They also warn people not to self-medicate or take antibiotics without a doctor's prescription. Thailand reported 1,895 cases as of 17 July this year, including 25 deaths (CFR: 1.32%). Both cases and deaths are mainly in people aged over 60. Authorities recommend avoiding wading or muddy areas, or wearing protective gear such as boots and gloves, and washing the body after contact. If symptoms appear within one to two weeks after wading, people should seek medical care immediately and report their exposure history.

as0LVQe3UFqn5oNu5mzJTg.zh: 菲律賓報告1例死亡病例,病患於今年3月曾被犬隻咬傷,於7月下旬於馬拉拘留中心出現嘔吐、意識模糊、肌肉痙攣及無法進食等症狀後轉至醫療中心,隔日死亡,當局已啟動疫情調查,及提供116名密切接觸者暴露後預防性疫苗接種。
as0LVQe3UFqn5oNu5mzJTg.en: The Philippines reported one death. The patient had been bitten by a dog in March this year. In late July, he developed vomiting, confusion, muscle spasms and inability to eat at a detention center in Manila, was transferred to a medical center, and died the following day. Authorities have launched an outbreak investigation and provided post-exposure vaccination to 116 close contacts.

oZ-nNhJcXbxGoyQDtBv5Cg.zh: 菲律賓馬拉都會區奎松市近期因洪水導致疫情上升,今年截至7/25累計報告139例病例,其中21例死亡(CFR:15%),較去年(2024)同期增加36%,病患多為男性(82%),年齡介於5-75歲,當局呼籲民眾倘於涉水後2-30天內出現相關症狀,應立即就醫,另提供doxycycline作為暴露後預防藥物;另馬拉市淹水地區近期亦報告4例死亡病例,13例確定病例,當局已提供逾31,000名居民預防性抗生素(doxycycline)。
oZ-nNhJcXbxGoyQDtBv5Cg.en: Flooding has driven up cases in Quezon City, Metro Manila. As of 25 July this year, 139 cases have been reported, including 21 deaths (CFR 15%), a 36% increase over the same period in 2024. Most patients are male (82%), aged 5–75 years. Authorities urge anyone who develops symptoms 2–30 days after wading through floodwater to seek medical care immediately, and doxycycline is offered as post-exposure prophylaxis. In flooded areas of Manila, 4 deaths and 13 confirmed cases have also recently been reported, and authorities have provided preventive antibiotics (doxycycline) to more than 31,000 residents.

PdV3ncAULmpiulSuqPYNkA.zh: 菲律賓疫情上升,於5/11-24報告6,720例病例,較前二週(6,192例)為多,今年迄今累計123,291例病例,預期病例數因雨季到來而持續上升。 越南今年迄今累計22,974例病例及5例死亡,其中,胡志明市疫情上升,尤其兒童醫院病例數快速增加,該市6/2-8報告320例病例,今年迄今累計8,595例病例。
PdV3ncAULmpiulSuqPYNkA.en: Dengue is rising in the Philippines. From 11 to 24 May, 6,720 cases were reported, more than the 6,192 in the previous two weeks. So far this year, 123,291 cumulative cases have been reported, and cases are expected to keep rising with the arrival of the rainy season. Viet Nam has reported 22,974 cumulative cases and 5 deaths so far this year. In Ho Chi Minh City, cases are rising, with a rapid increase at children's hospitals; the city reported 320 cases in 2–8 June and 8,595 cumulative cases so far this year.

mMhs5GpGk06h0-6YghJOpw.zh: 菲律賓6/4公布今年第一季新增5,101例感染病例,較去年同期增加50%,其中約95%為男性,病例年齡主要分布於15-34歲,主要傳播方式為男男性(MSM)行為,當局已加強藥物與匿名篩檢服務,並建議宣布為公共衛生緊急狀態。
mMhs5GpGk06h0-6YghJOpw.en: The Philippines announced on 4 June that 5,101 new infections were reported in the first quarter of this year, 50% higher than the same period last year. About 95% were male, and most cases are aged 15–34. The main mode of transmission is sex between men (MSM). Authorities have strengthened access to medication and anonymous testing services, and a public health emergency declaration has been recommended.

Q2iDq27Yev3UuCNV9LxXMA.zh: 菲律賓中部錫基霍爾島報告6例病例(前已掌握),其中2例死亡,病患最初被懷疑鼻疽(Glanders),後經實驗室確診為類鼻疽。當局已啟動調查及監測措施,並呼籲有暴露於泥濘及淹水風險者,應穿戴靴子和手套等防護裝備,以降低接觸污染源之風險。
Q2iDq27Yev3UuCNV9LxXMA.en: Siquijor Island in central Philippines reported 6 cases (already identified), 2 of which were fatal. The patients were initially suspected to have glanders, but laboratory testing confirmed melioidosis. Authorities have launched investigation and surveillance measures and urge people at risk of exposure to mud and flooding to wear protective equipment such as boots and gloves to reduce the risk of contact with the contaminated source.

NZdXBMLC5a9VzAhkCVARSA.zh: 亞洲:菲律賓南部民答那峨島疫情上升,5/22報告累計3省15例,其中南哥打巴托省10例、蘇丹庫達拉省3例、馬京達瑙省2例。另該島南部三寶顏錫布省報告該省首例,為3歲女童,於5/5就診採檢後確診,目前隔離治療,相關接觸者追蹤中。 非洲:  衣索比亞報告該國首起疫情,病患為該國南部邊境小鎮摩亞雷(Moyale) 1個月齡以下嬰兒及其母親,據調查,病患父親曾跨境前往鄰國,當局已隔離相關接觸者,並追蹤感染源,初步結果顯示為跨境傳播;當地為該國重要經貿及交通樞紐,與肯亞接壤,肯國近期有報告病例。 迦納今年截至5/21累計9例,病患分布於該國首都阿克拉及西部大區,該國於去(2024)年報告13例IIb型病例;多哥於5/16報告該國首例,截至5/22報告3例,皆分布於首都洛梅,病患隔離中,相關接觸者追蹤中。  歐洲:東南歐北馬其頓報告該國首起病例,2例確診病患皆已隔離接受治療,當局展開疫調中。
NZdXBMLC5a9VzAhkCVARSA.en: Asia: the outbreak in the southern island of Mindanao in the Philippines is rising. As of 22 May, 15 cases had been reported cumulatively in 3 provinces: 10 in Lanao del Sur, 3 in Sultan Kudarat and 2 in Maguindanao. The island's southern province of Zamboanga Sibugay also reported its first case, a 3-year-old girl who was diagnosed after seeking care and sampling on 5 May. She is in isolation, and close contacts are being traced. Africa: Ethiopia reported its first outbreak in the country, involving an infant under one month old and the infant's mother, in Moyale, a small town on the southern border. According to investigation, the infant's father had travelled across the border to a neighbouring country. Close contacts have been isolated and the source of infection is being traced; preliminary results indicate cross-border transmission. The town is an important economic and transport hub on the border with Kenya, which has recently reported cases. Ghana reported 9 cases cumulatively this year as of 21 May, distributed in the capital Accra and the Western Region; Ghana reported 13 clade IIb cases in 2024. Togo reported its first case on 16 May; as of 22 May, 3 cases had been reported, all in the capital Lomé. Patients are in isolation and close contacts are being traced. Europe: North Macedonia reported its first case; the 2 confirmed patients are isolated and receiving treatment, and authorities have launched an epidemiological investigation.

1K9TbEBHnuDxSjtiOrPJEw.zh: 菲律賓中部錫基霍爾島報告6例人類感染病例,病患住院治療後病況穩定,當局已啟動調查及監測措施,並呼籲民眾避免接觸及食用生病及死亡動物,本案為該島首次出現疫情。感染症狀包括發燒、身體疼痛、頭痛、打噴嚏、發冷和胸痛;嚴重情況下,導致皮膚潰瘍和肺炎。
1K9TbEBHnuDxSjtiOrPJEw.en: Siquijor Island in central Philippines reported 6 human infection cases. After hospitalization, the patients' condition is stable. Authorities have launched investigation and surveillance measures and urge people to avoid contact with, and consumption of, sick or dead animals. This is the island's first outbreak. Symptoms of infection include fever, body aches, headache, sneezing, chills and chest pain; in severe cases they can lead to skin ulcers and pneumonia.

pBhOi3oJg2xymve6-OuwQQ.zh: 菲律賓南部達沃市4/16報告新增2例II型病例,均於4/16確診並隔離治療,其中1例因自身免疫功能不全而引發併發症死亡,當局已匡列並追蹤密切接觸者,呼籲民眾倘有症狀,應儘速就醫。
pBhOi3oJg2xymve6-OuwQQ.en: In Davao City in the south of the Philippines, 2 new clade II cases were reported on 16 April; both were confirmed and isolated for treatment on 16 April. One patient died from complications caused by an immune deficiency. Authorities have identified and are tracing close contacts, and urge anyone with symptoms to seek medical care as soon as possible.

00xcxyhh_jtESSqgg-FHbw.zh: 菲律賓疫情更新,今年截至4/21累計95,262例病例,致死率為0.36%,病例數高於去年同期54,556例。 東加疫情更新,最近1天新增7例病例,自今年2月宣布疫情爆發迄今累計625例病例及3例死亡,病例分布以瓦瓦烏群島300例及湯加塔布島265例為多,主要流行型別為DENV-2。
00xcxyhh_jtESSqgg-FHbw.en: Philippines update: as of 21 April this year, 95,262 cases have been reported cumulatively, with a CFR of 0.36%. This is higher than the 54,556 cases in the same period last year. Tonga update: 7 cases were reported in the most recent day. Since the outbreak was announced in February this year, 625 cases and 3 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Cases are mainly distributed in the Vava'u island group (300 cases) and Tongatapu Island (265 cases). The main circulating serotype is DENV-2.

fjD0sHjD3UjD6uJHSLIRJA.zh: 菲律賓西內羅省(Negros Occidental)巴克羅德市(Bacolod City)今年截至3/22累計報告27例病例,較去年同期(11例)上升,當局發布傷寒警告。
fjD0sHjD3UjD6uJHSLIRJA.en: In Bacolod City, Negros Occidental, Philippines, 27 cases had been reported cumulatively this year as of 22 March, up from 11 in the same period last year. Authorities have issued a typhoid warning.

ZJP56bAI5AGgA5PRwMpAlg.zh: 菲律賓中部西內羅斯省(Negros Occidental)疫情上升,今年截至3/29累計報告387例病例,為去年同期約1.8倍,病例分布於7個城市,以卡班卡蘭市(Kabankalan)(96例)為多,大多數病患為11-20歲族群。當局呼籲民眾須注意飲用水衛生。
ZJP56bAI5AGgA5PRwMpAlg.en: In Negros Occidental, central Philippines, the outbreak is rising. As of 29 March this year, 387 cases had been reported cumulatively, about 1.8 times the same period last year. Cases were distributed across 7 cities, with the largest number in Kabankalan City (96 cases). Most patients are aged 11–20. Authorities urge the public to pay attention to drinking water hygiene.

bsUMud0j45AiRUqyLifeNQ.zh: 菲律賓疫情上升,最近2週報告約14,000例病例,今年截至3/15累計報告76,000餘例病例,較去年同期上升約78%,以卡拉巴松15,000餘例病例為最多,其次為首都地區和呂宋島中部。 澳大利亞疫情更新,昆士蘭州湯斯維爾市2/19宣布爆發疫情,截至3/25累計9例確診病例及2例疑病例。
bsUMud0j45AiRUqyLifeNQ.en: Dengue is rising in the Philippines, with about 14,000 cases reported in the past two weeks. As of 15 March this year, more than 76,000 cases have been reported cumulatively, about 78% higher than the same period last year. Calabarzon region has the most cases, with over 15,000, followed by the National Capital Region and central Luzon. Australia update: an outbreak was declared in Townsville, Queensland, on 19 February; as of 25 March, 9 confirmed and 2 suspected cases have been reported cumulatively.

AlHPXIRwrPV3OB3yGKEW1A.zh: 菲律賓報告今年前2個月疫情上升,自1/1-2/22報告7,958例手足口病病例,與去年同期(2,665例)增加近3倍,其中4歲以下兒童佔56%、5-9歲占27%,病患多數來自4區,分別為中呂宋、民馬羅巴、首都及科地列拉區。
AlHPXIRwrPV3OB3yGKEW1A.en: The Philippines reported an increase in cases in the first two months of this year. From 1 January to 22 February, 7,958 hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) cases were reported, nearly three times the 2,665 cases in the same period last year. Children under 4 accounted for 56% and those aged 5–9 for 27%. Most cases came from four regions: Central Luzon, Mimaropa, the National Capital Region and the Cordillera region.

eTDOAwSN4oKhyywvno_GyA.zh: 菲律賓西內羅斯省疫情上升,該省今年截至3月中旬累計報告344例病例、其中3例死亡,病例數比去年同期增加91%,並以卡班卡蘭市(Kabankalan)78例為最多,當局呼應民眾須注意水源衛生。
eTDOAwSN4oKhyywvno_GyA.en: Typhoid cases are rising in Negros Occidental Province in the Philippines. As of mid-March this year, the province has reported 344 cumulative cases, including 3 deaths. This is 91% higher than the same period last year. Kabankalan City has the most cases, with 78. Authorities remind residents to pay attention to water source hygiene.

glrKtAQ5EATmSwwAzT0LNA.zh: 菲律賓報告2024年全年累計426例病例,且所有病例均已死亡,其中,45%病例係寵物咬傷所致,2024年病例數高於2022、2023年。 印度報告2024年全年累計54例死亡病例,較2022年(21例)增加2.5倍,多數病例發生於馬哈拉什特拉邦,其中,30%病例為15歲以下孩童。WHO統計該國死亡數占全球36%,為狂犬病流行區。另該國2024年通報咬人事件累計219.5萬例,2023年為304萬餘例。
glrKtAQ5EATmSwwAzT0LNA.en: The Philippines reported 426 cumulative human rabies cases for the whole of 2024, and all of them died. 45% of cases were caused by pet bites. The number of cases in 2024 was higher than in 2022 and 2023. India reported 54 cumulative deaths for the whole of 2024, an increase of 2.5 times compared with 21 in 2022. Most cases occurred in Maharashtra State, and 30% of cases were children under 15. WHO estimates that India accounts for 36% of global rabies deaths, and it is a rabies-endemic country. In 2024 the country reported 2.195 million cumulative animal bite incidents; in 2023 it reported over 3.04 million.

6ESzxNGHW6IvMrf9ltVKKg.zh: 東南亞疫情嚴峻:  菲律賓:該國今年截至3/1報告922例,較去年同期683例上升35%,其中近70%未接種疫苗。 越南:今年迄今報告近4萬例疑病例,其中超過3,400例確診及5例死亡,病例分布以南部地區為多,多數病例為15歲以下兒童,該國疫苗接種率仍低,部分省分接種率僅40%。
6ESzxNGHW6IvMrf9ltVKKg.en: Measles is severe in Southeast Asia. Philippines: this year, as of 1 March, 922 cases have been reported, up 35% from 683 in the same period last year; nearly 70% were unvaccinated. Viet Nam: nearly 40,000 suspected cases have been reported so far this year, of which over 3,400 are confirmed, with 5 deaths. Cases are concentrated in the south, and most are children under 15. Viet Nam's vaccination rate remains low, and in some provinces coverage is only 40%.

OumBe4A1sdGAHicpNvYQSQ.zh: 菲律賓西內羅省疫情上升,今年1-2月累計報告1,151例病例,明顯高於去年同期病例數,主要分布於Bago City 232例。 阿根廷疫情更新,自去年第31週迄今年第5週累計報告28,815例病例,467例確診,其中443例無旅遊史(94.9%),4例病例與器官移植相關,主要流行型別為DEN-1及DEN-2。 東加疫情上升,最近1天新增30例病例,今年迄3/4累計129例病例,無死亡病例,以瓦瓦烏群島63例病例為多。
OumBe4A1sdGAHicpNvYQSQ.en: Dengue is rising in Negros Occidental, Philippines. Cases reported in January and February this year total 1,151, clearly higher than the same period last year, mainly in Bago City with 232 cases. Argentina update: from week 31 of last year to week 5 of this year, 28,815 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 467 were confirmed; of the confirmed cases, 443 (94.9%) had no travel history, and 4 cases were related to organ transplantation. The main circulating serotypes are DEN-1 and DEN-2. Tonga's outbreak is rising: 30 new cases were reported in the last day, and 129 cases have been reported cumulatively to 4 March this year, with no deaths; most are in the Vava'u island group, with 63 cases.

a6e_oqPGmDlMhgRAK9Mogw.zh: 菲律賓疫情上升,今年截至2/1累計報告28,234例病例(CFR:0.35%),較去年同期上升約40%;馬拉大都會、中央呂宋及卡拉巴松區之病例數明顯上升,其中,奎松市今年迄今累計1,700餘例病例及10例死亡,病例數較去年同期上升約200%。
a6e_oqPGmDlMhgRAK9Mogw.en: Dengue is rising in the Philippines. As of 1 February this year, 28,234 cases have been reported cumulatively (CFR: 0.35%), about 40% higher than the same period last year. Metro Manila, Central Luzon and Calabarzon have seen marked increases in cases. In Quezon City, over 1,700 cases and 10 deaths have been reported so far this year, an increase of about 200% over the same period last year.

N7gerXuI-3sE0P82Qs4mOA.zh: 法屬留旺島疫情明顯上升,於2025年第4週新增31例病例,自2024年8月迄今累計529例本土病例,以勒唐蓬、聖皮耶及萊唐薩萊之疫情較為嚴峻。 菲律賓疫情更新,達沃市2024年累計12例病例,當局已加強宣導以免疫情擴大。
N7gerXuI-3sE0P82Qs4mOA.en: The outbreak on French Réunion has risen markedly, with 31 new cases in week 4 of 2025. Since August 2024, 529 local cases have been reported cumulatively, with the outbreaks most severe in Le Tampon, Saint-Pierre and L'Étang-Salé. Philippines update: Davao City reported 12 cases cumulatively in 2024. Authorities have strengthened awareness campaigns to prevent the outbreak from spreading.

PA3gQGLoQqP8lJHzYnJM4Q.zh: 菲律賓疫情更新,達沃市2024年累計7,000餘例病例及55例死亡,高於2023年的6,700餘例病例,當局持續宣導並採取防治措施。 哥倫比亞疫情更新,該國西南部烏伊拉省爆發第2型血清型疫情,當局宣布進入公共衛生緊急狀態,該國2025年迄今累計19,000餘例病例。
PA3gQGLoQqP8lJHzYnJM4Q.en: Philippines update: Davao City recorded over 7,000 cases and 55 deaths in 2024, higher than the 6,700-plus cases in 2023. Authorities continue to run awareness campaigns and take control measures. Colombia update: a serotype 2 dengue outbreak has broken out in Huila Department in the southwest, and authorities have declared a public health emergency. Colombia has recorded over 19,000 cases cumulatively so far in 2025.

aLH25kT-HN5XJnUMGKPllQ.zh: 菲律賓疫情更新,該國西內羅省今年迄今累計報告250例病例及2例死亡,病例數較2024年同期63例增加297%,疫情明顯上升;該省於2024年累計6,700餘例病例及22例死亡,病例數較2023年增加354%。 巴西疫情更新,該國聖保羅州今年截至第2週累計報告約18,100例病例,其中4,340例確診,30例死亡;該州今年第1週(2024/12/29-2025/1/4)報告7,200餘例病例,高於去年同期6,500餘例。 伊朗疫情更新,該國去年累計報告逾1,000例病例,其中863例為本土病例,以南部恰巴哈爾市病例數852例為多。
aLH25kT-HN5XJnUMGKPllQ.en: Philippines epidemic update: In Negros Occidental Province, 250 cases and 2 deaths have been reported so far this year, a 297% increase over the 63 cases in the same period of 2024; the outbreak has risen markedly. In 2024 the province cumulatively reported over 6,700 cases and 22 deaths, a 354% increase in cases over 2023. Brazil epidemic update: In São Paulo State, about 18,100 cases had been reported so far this year as of week 2, of which 4,340 were confirmed and 30 died. In week 1 of this year (29 December 2024–4 January 2025), the state reported over 7,200 cases, higher than the over 6,500 in the same period last year. Iran epidemic update: Last year the country cumulatively reported over 1,000 cases, of which 863 were locally acquired; most were in Chabahar in the south, with 852 cases.

6-7cmsiMIu8R_15W1rZp6g.zh: 依WHO監測數據,泰國疫情於7月起驟升,達每月千餘例之規模,明顯高於往年;越南胡志明市9月起疫情爆發,疫情仍在上升,目前達每週300餘例之規模,並有擴散至鄰近同奈及平陽省之趨勢;馬來西亞今年疫情較往年嚴峻,惟下半年已趨緩;菲律賓、印疫情則持續流行,今年處於相對嚴峻之水平。
6-7cmsiMIu8R_15W1rZp6g.en: According to WHO surveillance data, Thailand's outbreak surged from July, reaching more than 1,000 cases a month, clearly higher than in previous years. In Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, an outbreak began in September and is still rising, currently at over 300 cases a week, and is spreading to neighbouring Đồng Nai and Bình Dương provinces.
